response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, CAST(risk_margin_count AS numeric) / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, share, ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share FROM shares WHERE timespan IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timespan

assumptions.assumption: Show time-in-force values present in matched records. Matched records with a NULL time in force count toward the overall total but do not form a time-in-force group. “How far” means absolute difference.

alternatives.interpretation: Show all four documented time-in-force values, including those with no matched risk/margin records.
alternatives.sql: WITH time_in_force(timespan) AS (VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')), counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), total AS (SELECT SUM(risk_margin_count) AS overall_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT t.timespan, COALESCE(c.risk_margin_count, 0) AS risk_margin_count, CAST(COALESCE(c.risk_margin_count, 0) AS numeric) / NULLIF(total.overall_count, 0) AS share FROM time_in_force AS t LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON c.timespan = t.timespan CROSS JOIN total) SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, share, ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan
